Commentary.Commentary: It was not just the guile of Tahir's spin that got the visitors. Wayne Parnell struck twice with the new ball and came back at the end to take one more. Coming back from an injury, Chris Morris too capped off a good day with a couple of wickets. Everyone bowled well for the hosts and that should please AB. They will bank on their batsmen to come good and chase down this total. Will Sri Lanka manage to spring a surprise? Join us for the chase in a while to know.

Sri Lanka have lost 82 for 7 and will be disappointed with the way they batted. The openers fell to the early swing but the 72-run stand for the third wicket between Kusal Mendis and Dinesh Chandimal steadied them. Chandimal was castled for 22 and despite the enterprising 62 from Kusal Mendis, they struggled for momentum. It was Imran Tahir who ran through the middle order to finish with figures of 10-0-26-3! De Silva chipped in with 28 to to take the score to 181 which still seems a below par one.
OUT! BOWLED! On a length and straight, Lakmal swings hard but misses. The ball hits the middle stump and pegs it back. SRI LANKA HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 181!
WIDE. Another one down the leg side, Suranga goes after it but misses.
Yorker outside off, Lakmal tries to dig it out but misses.
Good length ball outside off, defended from the crease.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
WIDE. Down the leg side, left alone.
Down the leg side, tucked through square leg for a run.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.
A short ball on middle, Lakmal swings hard but the ball goes off the inside half of the bat through fine leg. A single taken.
A length ball on middle, tucked through square leg for a single. There is a direct hit at the striker's end but it misses the stumps. Lakmal dives in but would have been gone had that hit.
A length ball on middle, LS looks to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. The ball goes towards third man as Sandakan is busy admiring his defensive shot. A leg bye taken.
Outside off, Lakshan pushes this towards point but Duminy gets across to his left and dives to stop the ball.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
WIDE. The batsman tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Down the leg side, Lakmal misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads behind square leg. A leg bye taken.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.

Full and outside off, Lakmal pushes it through cover-point and sets off for a single. But then he sends his partner back and JP Duminy comes haring in. He has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Sandakan was in though.
Outside off, defended off the back foot.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
WIDE. Slips this down the leg side, Sandakan misses his flick.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A short ball on middle, pulled over square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed towards mid off.
Lakshan Sandakan is the last man in.

OUT! Number 9 down and Sri Lanka's chances of reaching 200 go down the drain. Full and outside off, de Silva looked to go over the top, as mid on and mid off were inside the circle but the ball hit the top half of the bat. As a result, the ball went high in the air but did not have enough distance. Faf du Plessis ran to his right from mid off, kept his eyes on the ball and took a decent catch.
Wayne Parnell called back on for a spell at the death.
Outside off, Lakmal looks to defend but the ball goes off the outer half of the bat towards gully.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.
Suranga Lakmal is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! That looked dead plumb. Full and straight, Vandersay got across to flick but missed and was hit flush on the pads. Morris appealed, the umpire took his time but then raised his finger. Vandersay seemed to be disappointed with the decision, did he get bat on that? Nothing from the replays indicate any wood. He was hit across the line, so the ball seemed to be crashing into the stumps. Must have been disappointed on not getting that ball away then.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
A short ball around middle, pulled through square leg for a run.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Chris Morris returns for a spell.
Around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Full on middle and leg, flicked straight to square leg.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Full and outside off, pushed towards covers for a quick single.
Full and down the leg side, Vandersay looks to flick but misses. The ball goes off his pads through fine leg and the batsmen take a leg bye.
Imran Tahir returns for his last over.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot for a single.
A bouncer on middle, Vandersay ducks.
Full and outside off, driven towards long off for one.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a run.
Outside off, left alone.
A short ball on middle and leg, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on.
FOUR! Edged but no slip in place. Full and wide outside off, Vandersay looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge which goes on the ground through the vacant slip cordon to the third man fence.
Outside off, played straight to point.
WIDE. Down the leg side, Jeffrey lets it through.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Landed around off, defended from the crease.
Full and down the leg side, flicked towards fine leg for a single.
Wayne Parnell returns for a bowl.
Jeffrey Vandersay walks in to bat.

OUT! That is a superb catch! Every match that de Kock plays, more often than not, one sees such spectacular catches from him. Full and outside off, Kulasekara looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge. The ball goes low towards the keeper behind but de Kock flies to his right and takes it inches above the surface. 7 down now, still 9 overs left.
FOUR! Full and down the leg side, Kulasekara deflects it wide of the keeper to the fine leg keeper.
Full and outside off, Kulasekara feels for it and is beaten.
Outside off, run down to third man for a single.

EDGED, BUT SHORT! On a length outside off, pretty wide, Dhananjaya has a needless poke away from his body and gets an outside edge. But since it is played with soft hands, it does not carry to Faf du Plessis at first slip who dives to his left and parries it to de Kock.
A short ball down the leg side, de Silva lets it through. Wide signalled.
The umpire signals the start of the final Powerplay. Five fielders are now allowed to be outside the circle.
Short and outside off, perhaps the googly, punched straight to point. 150 UP FOR SRI LANKA!
Another flatter ball, worked through square leg for a run.
Full and outside off, defended back to the bowler.
Full on middle and leg, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
Goes back and works it properly this time through mid-wicket for a single.
Oohhh..... that one skid on after pitching around middle, de Silva went back to punch it perhaps towards long on but was beaten by pace and got a thick inside edge towards square leg.
Imran Tahir returns for a bowl. He has a couple of overs left.
Full and down the leg side, flicked through square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, driven sweetly but straight to short extra cover.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Outside off, pushed towards cover.
Full and straight, pushed towards mid on.
On a good length outside off, defended to the off side.
Kagiso Rabada is back on for a spell. Morris was warming up as well but AB has given the ball to his best bowler.
Full and outside off, watchfully kept out.
Chris Morris is warming up for a bowl!
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Nice comeback. Lands this on a good length outside off, Nuwan looks to defend but the ball moves away a touch and beats him.
FOUR! Terrific batting. A length ball again outside off, Kulasekara pulls it through mid-wicket and gets a boundary!
Down the leg side, flicked straight to square leg.

SIX! AUDACIOUS! The first biggie of the innings and it is time that Sri Lanka started to have a look at their run rate. A length ball outside off, Kulasekara swings this miles over long on and seems to get more height than distance but has enough to clear the boundary.
FOUR! That is a lovely shot. Full and outside off, de Silva leans and drives it through the covers for a boundary!
Banged in short, pulled through square leg for a couple.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
A short ball around off, fended to the leg side.
Full and outside off, Kulasekara looks to defend but the ball goes off the inside edge through fine leg. A run taken.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full and outside off, Nuwan looks to defend but the ball goes off the outside edge to third man. A run taken.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A short ball around middle, pulled wide of mid on.

SAFE. But not the right way to save your wicket. Full on middle, de Silva flicks it straight to short mid-wicket who has a shy the bowler's end. Kulasekara gets back in but the ball hits the stumps and a run out appeal is made. Replays show why. Kula just plonked his bat in when the throw came and luckily for him, he was saved just by a frame.
Direct hit! Is Kulasekara in trouble? Referred upstairs....
Outside off, watchfully defended.
The batsman fails to get bat on that one and is hit on the pad. One run added to the total. Leg bye signalled by the umpire.
Andile Phehlukwayo is back on for a bowl.
Nuwan Kulasekara is the new man in.

OUT! Not out given initially but then the right call is made in the end. Clean take by Parnell. Full and wide outside off, de Silva flays hard and the ball goes off the outside edge over point. Chris Morris covers good ground to his left and there should have been two runs. De Silva certainly thinks so and hares back but Gunaratne is ball-watching and sets off late. The throw comes in to de Kock who is aware of the situation and fires it to Parnell. Gunaratne is just halfway through and Parnell completes the run out, throwing the ball down in disgust and anger. It is referred upstairs and replays confirm that Parnell has collected the ball cleanly but then the third umpire presses the wrong button. He signals NOT OUT but quickly changes the decision. De Silva running out of partners now.
Run out, run out, run out! But why is Gunaratne still standing over there? Because he has been asked to. The umpires want to check whether Parnell took the bails off cleanly or not.

Oopsss... almost drags it back on! Lucky escape for de Silva. He looks to defend this one but the ball goes back off the bottom of the bat back onto the stumps. He is alert to deflect the ball away to the leg side.
Strays on the pads, Gunaratne helps it towards fine leg for a run.
A terrific delivery, spears in a full ball on middle and off, de Silva slips while trying to flick and somehow gets it wide of mid on for a single. Smiles.
Outside off, pushed towards point.
Full and outside off, pushed towards mid off.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Full and around middle, de Silva looks to paddle but the ball goes off the bottom edge through square leg.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Short and around off, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, run down neatly to third man. Andile Phehlukwayo runs to his left from deep backward point and dives near the ropes to stop the ball. Three runs taken.
The batsman drives this through the covers.

FOUR! Off the edge though. Short and outside off, Gunaratne looks to play at that but the ball bounces steeply. He ends up fending at it and takes his left glove off the bat. The ball though, takes the top half of the bat and goes towards the slip cordon, where it dies in front of Faf du Plessis at first slip. He goes to the ball with a bit of indecision and the ball goes through.

WIDE. Rough call. Full and outside off, Gunaratne initially thinks of going after it, then tries to withdraw his bat but misses. Parnell is not happy with the umpire's call and replays show that the bowler is not entirely at fault. That one just about grazed the wide margin.
Outside off, pushed wide of mid on for a quick single.
WIDE. Full and wide outside off, swinging away, de Silva reaches out to drive but misses.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Full and wide outside off, left alone.
Wayne Parnell is back on.
Full and outside off, punched off the back foot towards long on for a single.
Full and around off, pushed towards mid on.
Outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, driven towards short extra cover.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Landed outside off, de Silva waits for the ball to come to him and guides it past the keeper through third man for a couple.
Drinks.
Fuller outside off, Gunaratne comes forward and defends it.
Bowls it around off, Asela gets across and defends it watchfully.
Fuller on off, eased down to long on for a single.
Shorter outside off, de Silva looks to dab it down but misses again. That was very close!
Spears it outside off, de Silva looks to squeeze it down to third man but misses.
WIDE! Drifts this one down the leg side, de Silva leaves it all alone. A wide is signaled.
Shorter outside off, punched through covers for a couple by de Silva.
Fires it on the pads, Asela looks to work it through mid-wicket but gets a bit of an edge towards mid on. Top over from Tahir.
Too full outside off, eased down to long on for a single.
Floats it on off, de Silva comes forward and defends it watchfully.
Full toss outside off, Asela comes down the wicket and turns it through mid on for a single.
Asela Gunaratne is the new man in.

OUT! And it works instantly! Tahir bowls it outside off on a fuller length, Tharanga is lazy as he aims to drive it through covers without quite getting to the ball. The ball goes quickly to Duminy at short extra cover who leaps up to complete a good catch. That is a soft dismissal for any batsman, let alone a captain! Tahir has taken three and he is enjoying his time out there.
Goes round the wicket.
Outside off, Tharanga drives it towards short extra cover with a forward stride.
Tharanga looks to drive this one but it is not there to be driven and he ends up pushing it towards covers.
Tharanga plays this one towards point from his crease with an angled bat.
Shorter outside off, de Silva cuts it towards Tahir for a single.
Flatter on off, worked towards square leg for a quick single by Tharanga.
Fires it outside off, Tharanga pushes it towards covers from his crease.
Floats it on off, Tharanga comes forward and defends it back down the wicket.
JP Duminy to roll his arm over.
Dhananjaya de Silva walks in to bat.

OUT! Kusal falls despite the review! Flatter on middle, pitches and turns away ever so slightly, Kusal Mendis looks to work it through mid-wicket but is struck on his pads on his back foot. The players appeal and the umpire upholds it. Tahir is up and celebrating again. Kusal is not sure of the review but takes it anyway after a talk with his skipper at the other end. Replays show that it pitched in line, impact was in line and was hitting the stumps. So Kusal Mendis has to go and Tahir can celebrate his wicket. He has been superb today. Big wicket for South Africa, this!
Guides this one through point for a single.
Drives it through mid on for a single.

Brilliant stop, JP! Floats it on the stumps, Mendis comes down and heaves it over mid-wicket. JP runs across from long on, gets his right hand to it to keep the ball in play with a dive in air. Superb effort!
Floats it on off, Tharanga pushes it off the outer half through cover-point for a single.
Shorter outside off, Tharanga waits for it and dabs it towards short third man from his crease.
Another shorter one outside off, Mendis is happy to shoulder his arms to that one.

Angles it on a length just around off, Mendis has a poke at it. The keeper collects the ball and wonders if he should appeal as the bowler too was in two minds. He puts up his hand to appeal but there was no bat there.
Around off on a shorter length, Kusal Mendis is happy to let it go through.
Bouncer! Dug in short outside off, Mendis lets it go over him with a duck.
A tad short outside off, Tharanga places it towards the off side for a single.
Back of a length on off, Tharanga looks to defend it riding the bounce on that one and gets it towards square leg from his crease.
Too full outside off, Tharanga jams it down to long off for a single.
Eases this one through mid on for a single.
On the stumps, Mendis comes down on it and defends it carefully.
Leaves this one outside off watchfully.
Mendis works across and turns it towards mid-wicket from his crease.
Bowls the wrong 'un outside off, Mendis comes across and defends it with an outside edge towards the off side.
Bowls it around off, Tharanga stays back and defends it back down the wicket.
A touch short outside off, Tharanga guides it towards gully from his crease.
Shorter in length from round the wicket, Tharanga ducks under it in time. de Kock has a smile on his face, there is a lot of chatter suddenly around the batsman.
Tucks this one through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off on a length, left alone by Mendis.

FOUR! Shot, Mendis! Fuller outside off, Mendis sits a touch low and drives it hard through covers. The short extra cover fielder falls but cannot stop it, nor can the fielder going to his left from mid off. Superb shot from Mendis!
UPUL THARANGA walks in at number 5, replacing Chandimal.

OUT! Chandimal departs! Tahir bowls the googly around off, Chandimal plays for the turn, away from his body but to his horror, the ball spins back in. It slips through the huge gap between his bat and pad to disturb the timber. There is no review needed for this and Tahir is off and running. A vital 72-run stand comes to an end for Sri Lanka.
Flatter on the pads, Chandimal fails to turn it through the on side.
Outside off, Chandimal comes forward and pushes it towards covers.
On off, Chandimal comes forward and defends it back down the wicket.
Mendis works this one to long on for a single.
Floats it on the stumps, Mendis comes forward and nudges it towards the on side.
Fuller on the pads, Mendis whips it over square leg for a single.
Shorter one at a slower pace, Mendis gets across and looks to pull but the ball gets an edge but does not carry to the keeper.
Back of a length outside off, Chandimal glides it down to third man for a single.
Rabada bowls it short around off, Mendis pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Chandimal dabs this shorter one down to third man for a single.
8th ODI fifty for Kusal Mendis!
FIFTY! Angles it on the pads, Mendis works it to deep backward square leg for a single. That is fifty for him. He will know he has job left though.
Kagiso Rabada returns for a bowl.
Around off, Mendis taps it towards mid-wicket for a very quick single. There is a shy at the striker's end but Chandimal had got in.

NOT OUT! Good review, Kusal!  Tahir bowls this one on the stumps, Kusal Mendis looks to sweep it through square leg but seems to have missed it. The bowler and the keeper appealsand the umpire obliges. Kusal though goes for the review instantly, good confidence that. The replays confirm there was bat involved there and that saves Mendis.
Mendis has been adjudged LBW! He has reviewed it though....
Too full outside leg, Mendis turns it towards mid-wicket from his crease.
Loopy outside off, Chandimal mistimes his drive through mid on for a single.
Fires it on the stumps, keeps a touch low, Mendis does well to adjust to it and drag it through mid-wicket for a single.
Floats it outside off, Mendis comes forward and defends it with an inside edge towards square leg.
Shorter length on middle, Mendis pulls it down to deep fine leg for a single.
Angled outside off on a good length, Mendis pushes it towards covers from his crease.
WIDE! Slants it down the leg side on a shorter length, Mendis gets outside the line and raises his bat to let it go through.
Back of a length outside off, Mendis it from his crease.
FOUR! Pristine! Fuller outside off, Mendis stays in his crease and drives it through mid off for a boundary. That was nicely driven by Kusal.
On a length on off, Chandimal taps it towards mid-wicket from his crease for a quick single. There was a shy at the non-striker's end but wide of the stumps.
FOUR! Top shot! Outside off on a length, Chandimal comes forward and drives it on the up through covers for a boundary. Superb shot, that!
Plays this one back down the wicket from the crease.
Mendis sweeps it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
50-run stand up!
Turns this one towards mid-wicket where Miller fumbles and allows a single.
Almost! Chandimal looks to clip it through mid-wicket but does not quite hit it well. The ball falls short of mid-wicket.
Chandimal lunges forward and turns it towards the on side from his crease.
Floats it on off, Chandimal comes forward and defends it.
Time for some spin then! Imran Tahir called on for a bowl. He has a chat with AB about the field.
Too full outside off, Mendis drives it hard but finds Miller at short cover. He celebrates it for the crowd as it was clearly a bump ball.
Fuller length on off, Mendis comes forward and keeps it out from his crease.
This one is just wide enough outside off for Mendis to leave it all alone.
Chandimal looks to for another drive but mistimes it towards mid off. AB again looks to run Chandimal out at the non-striker's end but fails to pick up the ball in time.
Beaten! On a length outside off, Chandimal looks to whack it through covers but connects thin air.

Just wide! Around off, Mendis drives it just back down the wicket. He takes the bottom hand off that since he hit that in the air. The bowler cannot take it, AB de Villiers from mid off, goes to his right fumbles and concedes a run. AB was looking to throw the ball even before he collected the ball.
Slower one outside off, Chandimal comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Shorter outside off, Chandimal looks to carve it over the point region but misses.
Shorter length on the stumps, pulled down to fine leg for a single.
Outside off, Mendis rides the bounce and looks to punch it on the up but finds the point fielder.
Around off, Mendis gets behind the line of this one and defends it.
Good length on off, Mendis tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length on the stumps, Mendis tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Angles it on the stumps, Chandimal works it behind square on the leg side for a single. Chandimal thinks of the second but it is not on.
Fuller in length on off, Chandimal gets across and clips it towards mid on.
Length ball outside off, Chandimal opens the face of the bat and guides it towards point.
Fuller outside off, Chandimal comes forward and defends it back down the wicket.
Sprays this one down the leg side, Morris clips it down to fine leg for a single.
Drinks.
Sprays it on the pads, Mendis turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Bouncer! Dug in very short on the stumps, Mendis lets it go over him with a crouch. A wide is signaled.
Shorter outside off, Mendis looks to drag it through mid-wicket but fails to find the gap.
A back of a length delivery outside off, Mendis punches it on the up off his back foot.
Fuller outside off, Mendis comes forward and defends it.
This one is down the leg side, Mendis turns it towards mid-wicket.
Shorter outside off, Mendis ducks under it.
On the pads, Mendis clips it to square leg for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Mendis rides the bounce and defends it back down the wicket.
Angled on a length on stumps, Mendis clips it towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length around off, Mendis takes the bottom hand off his bat and defends it towards point.
A touch short on off, Mendis keeps it out from his crease.
Angles it fuller on off, Mendis drives it towards mid off from his crease. No run.
Chandimal gets across a touch and defends it towards mid on.
Bouncer! Chandimal ducks under a short one from Andile.

Shout for an lbw, run out too but no harm done! Mendis gets across and looks to heave it over short fine but gets it off the pads. There is a shy at the striker's end but it is wide as the bowler appeals for an lbw. They run an overthrow.
Too full outside off, Mendis drives it towards mid off. The fielder makes a good stop diving stop and hence Mendis has to get back in his crease.
Angles it on the stumps, Chandimal gets across and ticks it down to fine leg for a single.
Bowls this shorter in length outside off, Chandimal sits under it to allow it through.
Good length delivery outside off, Mendis punches it towards the fielder at point. No runs taken.
WIDE! Dug in short this time into the body, Mendis ducks under it. The umpire calls it a wide due to height.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Kusal goes for a flick but misses. The umpire has signaled that as a wide.
Length delivery outside off, Chandimal lunges and defends it on the off side with soft hands for a quick single. They are taking on the fielders for their quick singles.
Fuller this time, Chandimal gets to the line of the ball and defends it.
Length ball outside off, Mendis cuts it past the point fielder for a single.
Chandimal guides the length ball towards the fielder at third man for a single.
Short into the batsman, Chandimal ducks into the ever climbing bouncer. That's one for the over says the umpire.
FOUR! PLACED TO PERFECTION! Shortish outside off, Mendis cuts it past the fielder at point for a boundary. That was placed really well as the diving fielder could not get to it.
The rain is back and is a touch heavier this time.
Short delivery into the body, Chandimal pulls it towards fine leg for a single.
Angled into the pads, Mendis stays deep in his crease and pushes it on the on side for a quick single.
Fuller outside off, Mendis drives but cannot pierce the gap there. Straight to the fielder at covers.
Again sprayed on the pads, Chandimal dabs it with soft hands towards square leg for a quick single.
Slinging into the pads, Chandimal clips it but cannot find a run there as the fielder from mid-wicket is quick to cut it off.
Shorter again but does not carry like the last ball but Mendis shoulder's his arms to it.
Short and way outside off, Mendis sways out of the line of the delivery.
Angling in from a length, Chandimal defends it on the up with soft hands to sneak a quick single.
Good length delivery angling in, Chandimal gets forward and pushes it towards the fielder at point.
Fuller delivery into the stumps, Chandimal drives this one towards the fielder at mid on.
There is a slight drizzle in the air again. The groundstaff is ready
Short into the body, Chandimal tickles it fine and the fielder from fine leg cuts it off as he keeps the batsman down for a couple.
The umpire signals the start of the second Powerplay. Four fielders are now allowed outside the thirty yard circle for the next 30 overs.
FOUR! WIDTH AND PUNISHED! Shorter delivery outside off, Mendis cuts it through the point region for a boundary. There was no chance any fielder could get to it.
Mendis stays in his crease and defends it.
FOUR! FINDS THE GAP! Fuller delivery outside off, Kusal leans into this one. Sweetly timed through covers for a beautiful boundary.
Length ball outside off, Mendis leans forward and nudges it towards point.
Good length delivery outside off, Kusal shoulders his arms to it.
Length ball to start with, Kusal lunges forward and defends it.
Andile Phehlukwayo comes on for a bowl.
Fuller just outside off, Chandimal drives it firmly straight down the ground but Morris is quick to get low and stop it. Maiden from Morris to start with.
Full toss on the stumps, Chandimal gets his inner half of the bat towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, Chandimal leans into the drive. Straight towards the fielder at mid off.
Angling into the stumps, Chandimal clips it towards mid on.
Length delivery just outside off, Chandimal cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
Good length delivery outside off, left alone.
Chris Morris is brought on for a bowl.
FOUR! THAT'S DRIVEN! Length delivery outside off, Mendis elegantly drives it through the cover region for a boundary. That looks like a shot from a batsman in form.
FOUR! On a length and Mendis just lofts it over the mid on region. The ball goes two bounces into the ropes for a boundary.
JUST MISSED! Angling in from a good length, Mendis tries to defend it but the ball just misses the outside edge due to a bit of away movement.
Length ball on the stumps, Mendis punches this towards the fielder at covers.
Fuller just outside off, Chandimal crouches and guides it towards third man for a single.
Good length delivery angling in, Chandimal stays in his crease to defend it.
Good length delivery outside off, Mendis tries to poke at it but misses.
Mendis camps back and defends it.
FOUR! TIMED EXCEPTIONALLY WELL! Length ball on the stumps, Mendis stands and just drives it straight down the ground. Beats the diving fielder from mid on and races away for a boundary.
Length ball and Mendis drives it straight to the fielder at extra cover. They are unable to find the gaps.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Bouncer this time, Mendis ducks under it.
Chandimal defends the last ball of the over off his foot. Second maiden in a row.
Angling in, Chandimal gets squared up as he looks to defends it off his back foot. The bat turned in his hand this time.
Angling on the pads, Chandimal stays in his crease and clips it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Similar length outside off, Chandimal drives it straight to the fielder at mid off.
Length ball outside off, Dinesh opens the face off his bat and guides it towards point.
Angling in from a length, Chandimal reaches out to the line of the ball and defends it.
Fuller this time, Mendis defends it well off his front foot. That's the first maiden on the match.
Length ball into the stumps, Mendis drives it straight to mid off.
Short and into the body, Mendis ducks under this one.
Fuller this time, Mendis leans into it and drives it down the ground. The fielder at mid on makes a good diving save to his left. Mendis was half way down the pitch but was sent back. No run taken.
Dug in short this time by Rabada, Mendis stays in his place and sees the ball go through to the keeper.
Length ball into the stumps, Mendis prods forward and defends it towards mid off.
Good length delivery outside off, left alone by Chandimal.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Length ball outside off, Chandimal stays in his crease and defends it towards covers.
Fuller this time outside off, Chandimal guides this through the point region. He is off the mark with this. Rabada dives in the deep to save the boundary and keep them to a couple.
Comes around the wicket this time. Bowls it on a length and Chandimal has his defence well in place.
Dinesh Chandimal is the new man in for Sri Lanka.

EDGED AND TAKEN! The debutant's stay in the middle comes to an end. Good length delivery outside off, Weerakkody tries to cut it but the ball finds the outside edge. The ball flies away towards the second slip fielder. Amla doesn't miss those. Brilliant start for the hosts.
Wide outside off, Mendis is undisturbed there.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
BRAVE LEAVE THERE! Inswinging delivery from outside off, Mendis leaves it but the ball just misses the timber.
FOUR! Fuller on the stumps, Mendis just picks it up from his stumps and flicks it over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
EDGED BUT SAFE! Fuller outside off, Weerakkody has a nibble at it as he gets an outside edge towards the backward point fielder for a single.
FOUR! DEBUTANT'S OFF THE MARK! Length ball on the pads, Weerakkody just flicks it over the square leg region for a boundary. Top shot.
Swinging in from a length outside off, that's a brave leave by Mendis for the fourth time in a row.
Wide outside off, Mendis has shoulders his arms to it.
Goodish length outside off, Mendis shuffles and lets that through to the keeper.
Outside off this time, left alone.
FOUR! What a way to get off the mark! Length ball outside off, Mendis leans into it and drives it through the cover region to get off the mark. That's such a brilliant shot.
Kusal Mendis comes out to bat. The sun is out but there is a slight drizzle in the air.

OUT! THAT WAS PLUMB! Angling in from a length, Dickwella shuffles across and goes to defend. But he is totally beaten for pace and the ball stays low as it hits the pads. The moment they appealed the umpire has his finger up in the air. Wayne Parnell draws first blood.
Wayne Parnell to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Nearly Worked! Down the leg side, Weerakkody flicks it towards the fielder at leg gully. Miller, who is standing there has a shy at stumps but misses.
Couple of slips in place and a leg gully as well.
Full toss outside off, this time the batsmen has a go at it but is no where near the line of the ball.
Nasty start for the debutant! Short and climbing, he had no clue about it as he tries to defend it from his crease. Luckily the ball hits his gloves and does not carry to the fielder at point.
Shorter this time on the body, Dickwella nudges it towards square leg for a single. That's first runs on the board.
Again fuller on the stumps, Dickwella defends it well.
Fuller length to start with, almost a yorker just outside off. Dickwella has managed to keep it at bay.
The players are out in the middle. Niroshan Dickwella and debutant Sandun Weerakkody will be opening for the Sri Lankans. Kagiso Rabada will begin the proceedings for South Africa.

SRI LANKA XI - Niroshan Dickwella, Sandun Weerakkody, Kusal Mendis, Dinesh Chandimal (wk), Upul Tharanga (c), Dhananjaya de Silva, Asela Gunaratne, Nuwan Kulasekara, Jeffrey Vandersay, Suranga Lakmal, Lakshan Sandakan.
SOUTH AFRICA XI - Hashim Amla, Quinton de Kock(wk), Faf du Plessis, AB de Villiers (c), Jean-Paul Duminy, David Miller, Chris Morris, Wayne Parnell, Andile Phehlukwayo, Kagiso Rabada, Imran Tahir.
TOSS - South Africa win the toss and elect to bowl first.

AB de Villiers will lead the side, with Hashim Amla, Quinton de Kock, Faf du Plessis and Kagiso Rabada back after resting for the shortest format of the game. They blanked Australia 5-0 in the last ODI series they played and start as overwhelming favorites. Will Sri Lanka manage to spring a surprise with a young and inexperienced side? Let's see.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of the first of the five-match ODI series between South Africa and Sri Lanka at St George's Park, Port Elizabeth. The hosts won the Test series but the visitors came back hard in the T20I series to take it 2-1. That should renew the confidence of a side which failed to compete for long in the whites. The ODIs though will be a different game altogether with the return of the big stars for the home side.
